name: playzin
description: Playzin — um console caseiro que roda jogos HTML/JS a partir de cartuchos (pendrives).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @playzin/shared && npm run build -w @playzin/sdk && npm run build -w playzin && npm run build -w @playzin/daemon && npm run build -w @playzin/launcher && npm run build -w hello-playzin
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @playzin/daemon
